output.headline: The two buyer universes share only Blackstone and TPG Capital, and Health IT sponsors can pay the ask while Dental sponsors cannot.
sentences: Only Blackstone and TPG Capital sit on both lists, with Blackstone at High conviction for each target; the rest of each list is specific to that target. [Q:shared]
TPG Capital is Medium conviction for Health IT but High for Dental, because its median deal of $88M is under half the $300M EV of the Health IT target. [Q:shared, Q:target_a]

Health IT has strategics Evolent Health and Epic Systems at High conviction; Dental has strategics Heartland Dental and Aspen Dental (ADMI) plus sponsors Hellman & Friedman, General Atlantic and Welsh Carson, all High. [Q:only_a, Q:only_b]
Health IT's defensible multiple is 21.4x and sponsors clear their 20% target return at the ask; Dental's is 13.7x and sponsors do not clear the 20% target. [Q:target_a, Q:target_b]
